'''2021 Worlds Throwback Event''' (Prem-RefII) was the Players Committee Premiere–Reflections II constructed event at the 2021 World Championship weekend in Arlington, Virginia, 8 October 2021. [[Stephen Skilton]] finished 1st in the published field of 16.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/</ref> The Players Committee's Worlds wrap-up gives a field of 15 players, and only one or two dropped.<ref name="wrap21">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-world-championship-wrap-olson-wins-again/ 2021 World Championship Wrap – Olson Wins Again!], starwarsccg.org (18 October 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012175708/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-world-championship-wrap-olson-wins-again.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc-900099703323111474">"it was 15 people when only 1 or 2 dropped.", quickdraw3457 [KAGI] in #alternate-formats, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (19 October 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749418802441093192/900099703323111474 Discord message]</ref> One match was streamed live in each round on the Players Committee's [[Swccgpc (Twitch channel)|Twitch channel]], and the streams were later posted to its YouTube channel.<ref name="dc-898183728487088128">"1 match-up was live streamed for each game", JaredNap in #alternate-formats, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (14 October 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749418802441093192/898183728487088128 Discord message]</ref>
